title: Life Is Strange: True Colors
shortDescription: Life Is Strange: True Colors helps define a Nintendo Switch adventure path in GameAtlas through original editorial framing and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Makes a documented adventure option easier to find in the Nintendo Switch path.
Uses a factual reference path instead of an aggregate score or review.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog entry
signals.rationale: Mapped for the Nintendo Switch adventure discovery path using the frozen Wikidata metadata snapshot; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
